| description = Two of these beefy clerics guard [[Kallis Stormcaller]] behind the Arena stadium on the way to [[Derakor the Vindicator]]'s bridge. Their combination of [[Complete Healing]] and Enrage can be a headache for many raids. One suggested strategy is to have all the melee push with a designated MA who is not the tank, while the tank ensures the giant is pointed away from nearby walls.
<br>
Certainly tougher than Adjutants, but confirmation on exact stats needed. Not to be confused with the warriors, [[Protector of Zek]], which guard the arena's back door.
